item.title: Shop Thief Jailed After Arrest in Market Harborough
item.description: A thief who targeted shops across Market Harborough, Wigston and Leicester has been jailed for 20 weeks. Simon Chamberlain was arrested after attempting to steal beauty products worth more than £600 from Sainsbury’s on Springfield Street last month. The 55-year-old, of Pilkington Road in Leicester, pleaded guilty to multiple theft offences at Leicester Magistrates’ Court. […]
